title: Soldiers wounded in Basilan ambush now 13; Teodoro says attack unrelated to peace process
summary: The number of soldiers wounded in Monday’s military convoy ambush in Tipo-Tipo town has risen to 13, with eight remaining under medical treatment in hospitals.
